terminology_decision.best_headline: exact left-nullspace inconsistency certificate for a declared finite-dimensional coboundary class
terminology_decision.why_not_row_space: For Mc=d, consistency asks whether d lies in the column space of M. The separating vector lies in ker(M^T), the orthogonal complement of that column space.
terminology_decision.why_not_fredholm_headline: The finite matrix statement is an immediate dimension/orthogonality fact; invoking Fredholm as the headline inflates a routine lemma and obscures the source-specific certificate.
terminology_decision.why_not_farkas_headline: No inequalities, positivity cone, or sign restrictions occur. Farkas is neighboring history, not the exact form being used.
terminology_decision.role_of_primitive_integer_scaling: Primitivity makes the witness canonical up to sign and compact for audit; integrality makes replay exact. Neither creates a stronger mathematical exclusion than the left-null separation itself.
